title: Playlist and Yearbook
author: O. M. Dunmore
blurb: Juniper Coldharbour, a scholarship student at an academy with too many secrets, has spent fifteen years being so careful it hurts. Then the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
